# Browser
## Stop: choose the right surface before any browser action
Explicit browser intent wins: if the user names the in-app browser or Chrome, or asks to open, show, or navigate to a page; inspect its visual or interactive state; or interact with its UI, continue with Browser and do not substitute a connector.

Do not initialize Browser for that operation until the query is complete. Use the non-browser tool when available. If it handles the current operation, continue the larger workflow without Browser for that operation. Use Browser when no such tool exists, the tool cannot access the resource or lacks a required capability, or UI work remains; use available browser context before asking the user to repeat it.

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state.

item.text:
# VFX Reference Dossier — aura

## Candidate 1: Stygian Plague Bearer Effect (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Stygian Plague Bearer Effect
- primary_url: [official announcement with embedded video](https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3180474)
- secondary_urls: [direct showcase video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EVcP9Tiqu30), [official shop page](https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/StygianPlagueBearerEffect)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The instant toggle produces a persistent, actor-centered field with no path signature. Dark-blue flames communicate continuous aura activity, while enemy damage supplies clear application feedback rather than a projectile impact.
- readability_notes: Strong color contrast and a stable player-centered footprint remain readable at the isometric camera. The boundary is somewhat soft, so peripheral flame density must carry the radius.

## Candidate 2: Conviction Aura (Diablo II: Resurrected)
- source_game: Diablo II: Resurrected
- skill_or_mtx_name: Conviction
- primary_url: [D2R Skills & Abilities — Conviction Aura](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aDa8ZWS8ano)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: This is an exact exemplar: a continuously active, character-centered debuff aura with periodic visual pulses and recipient-side status feedback. It demonstrates how an aura can communicate influence without filling the entire radius with opaque effects.
- readability_notes: The repeating ground motif and affected-enemy markers survive the distant gameplay camera well. Exact range is inferred between pulses rather than continuously outlined.

## Candidate 3: War Banner and Dread Banner (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: War Banner and Dread Banner
- primary_url: [official skill-reveal video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2USIImzhApw)
- secondary_urls: [official announcement and mechanics description](https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2253788/page/1)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: These are explicitly aura skills with an instant activation, sustained field, and emphatic placement beat. The planted-banner version is a useful stationary-emitter variation on the archetype, preserving radial delivery and no traveling payload.
- readability_notes: The banner establishes an unmistakable center, while the circular field communicates area ownership cleanly. The footage reflects the original 2018 implementation, so treat it as a VFX reference rather than current mechanical documentation.

## Candidate 4: Divine Righteous Fire (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Divine Righteous Fire Alternate Skill Effect
- primary_url: [official showcase video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zWn6nVUFK6E)
- secondary_urls: [official shop page](https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/DivineRighteousFire)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: Righteous Fire is a damaging variant of the same move: a persistent, actor-centered radial field with no path or directional motion. Enemies crossing the field provide continuous impact/application evidence.
- readability_notes: Bright white flames create a highly legible footprint against dark environments. The luminous center is dense and could obscure the actor if copied without attenuation.

## Candidate 5: Aura of Censure and Night’s Chill (Grim Dawn)
- source_game: Grim Dawn
- skill_or_mtx_name: Aura of Censure + Night’s Chill aura-farmer build
- primary_url: [Crate Entertainment forum post with linked gameplay](https://forums.crateentertainment.com/t/1-2-1-2-lazy-farmer-strolling-and-killing-with-zero-dps/139623)
- secondary_urls: [direct “Lazy Aura Farmer” gameplay video](https://youtu.be/WW0CDK1O9so)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The character kills enemies by proximity while moving normally, making this a particularly literal no-path aura reference. It provides extended combat coverage of sustained activation and recipient-side damage feedback.
- readability_notes: Enemy reactions and burn effects remain perceptible during ordinary isometric combat. Multiple auras and equipment procs overlap, so it is better for stress-testing practical legibility than isolating one pristine effect.

## Search log
- Searched official Path of Exile shop, forum, and YouTube results for aura MTX, Celestial Aura, Stygian Aura, Lava Aura, Void Emperor Aura, Plague Bearer, Righteous Fire, War Banner, and Dread Banner.
- Found official Celestial, Stygian, Lava, and Void Emperor aura videos, but most primarily cover the already-active loop and lack recipient/application footage; the stronger temporal references were promoted above.
- Searched Diablo III official pages for Mantra of Conviction and War Cry. The pages verify mechanics but provided no useful isolated footage, so they were not promoted.
- Searched Diablo II: Resurrected for Conviction, Battle Orders, and aura-animation footage. Conviction produced the clearest skill-specific video; no equally clean Battle Orders source surfaced.
- Searched Grim Dawn for Aura of Censure and Field Command. Aura-farmer gameplay was useful; older build videos contained too many layered procs or malformed/expired links.
- Searched Last Epoch Holy Aura and Lost Ark Paladin Holy Aura/class showcases. Results were mostly text-only skill pages, old long-form build guides, or footage without a clean isolated aura segment.
